invention.ref: Waterpipes (qalyān/narghile) emerge in the Persian–Indian sphere after tobacco’s arrival
invention.ref_zh: 烟草传入后，波斯–印度一带出现水烟袋（qalyān/narghile）

popularization.ref: Hookah smoking spreads widely across West, South and Central Asia
popularization.ref_zh: 水烟在西亚、南亚与中亚广泛流行

locations.place_label_zh: 伊朗伊斯法罕一带（波斯水烟传统）
印度阿格拉一带（莫卧儿宫廷语境）

notes: 水烟壶常被说成莫卧儿宫廷医师阿布·法特赫·吉拉尼在印度发明，但更可能是他把波斯式水烟引入印度；波斯方面在十六世纪中后期已有水烟证据。起源究竟偏波斯还是印度仍有争议，本条目取约1580年代为粗标。
notes_en: A common story credits Mughal physician Abu’l-Fath Gilani in India, but he more likely introduced a Persian-style waterpipe there; Persian evidence already exists in the mid–late sixteenth century. Whether the origin leans Persian or Indian remains disputed; this entry uses a rough 1580s mark.
summary_zh: 水烟壶约于十六世纪末出现在波斯–印度文化圈；常被归于莫卧儿宫廷，但更可能源自波斯传统，起源地仍有争议。
summary_en: The hookah emerged in the late-sixteenth-century Persian–Indian sphere. Often tied to the Mughal court, it more likely grew from Persian practice; its exact origin remains disputed.
summary_ja: 水タバコは16世紀末のペルシア・インド圏に現れた。ムガル宮廷と結び付けられることが多いが、ペルシアの習慣から広がった可能性が高く、正確な起源は争われている。
